_comment: Worked examples for 'Draft with AI' (mapcards.similar_recipes): a description and the draft that answers it.
The nearest few to a user's description are shown to the model beside it, because an example teaches how
actions fit together -- a loop, a closed If, a value in the right argument -- better than a rule does.
'description' and 'also' are matched against the user's words; 'held_out' is never matched and is for
tests, which ask whether a differently-worded description still finds its recipe.
'args' are keyed by the id the editor gives each argument; tests build every recipe through the real
pipeline, so one that names a missing action, argument or choice fails there.
